policies.unrestricted: Original 0..101 search retained for exact replay
policies.active: 1..100 and at least one accepted and one rejected raw validation referral
policies.active20: Sensitivity: at least20 accepted and20 rejected raw validation referrals

selection: Maximum weighted validation F1, ties within1e-12 choose highest probe threshold then highest judge cutoff. Test never selects. Infeasible policies retained, not replaced.
probes: Original full-validation probe-only retained separately, plus sample-validation-tuned probe-only reference using same candidates/weights as cascade.
data: Exact existing IDs, gold, weights, score artifacts; no inference or retraining. API scopes conditional on valid responses. Original scores.npz replay-verified against raw exports.
bootstrap: 2000 paired stratified test resamples within each cell, census strata fixed; conditional on frozen validation choices. No aggregate independence claim across backbones/judges.
new_constraints: Post-hoc protocol amendment; original results retained. Functional activity enforced on validation only; test activity reported.
